newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Astra says settles patent row with Eisa.
newsitem.headline: Astra says settles patent row with Eisa.

text.p: Swedish drugs company Astra on Thursday said it had settled a patent dispute with Japan's Eisai.

The dispute was over products containing the proton pump inhibiting substances omeprazole, that is marketed under brand names Losec, Prilosec, Antra, Mopral and Omepral, and rabeprazole, Astra said in a statement.
"The two companies have today reached an amicable settlement and agreed to terminate all pending and potential legal action with immediate effect," Astra said.
"The settlement involves mutual recognition of certain intellectual property rights and payment of royalties to both companies."
Astra said Eisai recognises the value and strength of Astra's patents and patent applications in the field of proton pump inhibitors.
The settlement grants Eisai a licence from Astra to make and market globally products containing rabeprazole on a royalty fee basis.
Astra said it recognised the value and strength of Eisai's intellectual property rights covering rabeprazole and formulations containing proton pump inhibitors.
The settlement grants Astra a licence to certain formulation technologies developed by Eisai for certain future omeprazole formulations subject to a royalty fee to Eisai.
